title: France's Confidence Vote Crisis Collides With a Stagnant Economy · 02 Sep
keywords: France, confidence vote, political crisis, minority government, GDP growth, inflation, eurozone, EU fiscal rules, austerity, budget, French economy, European stability, deficit, public debt
notes: France is navigating a dangerous convergence of political paralysis and economic fragility, as a minority government faces a confidence vote that could topple it before a contested budget is passed. With second-quarter growth revised to zero and inflation still above comfort levels, the stakes extend well beyond Paris, touching the broader eurozone and Europe's capacity to enforce fiscal discipline. The crisis is testing whether a major European democracy can make hard economic choices while retaining public consent.
